Prepare Detection Data for Particle Filter

Source: R/2.0_function_particle_filter.R
prepare_detection_data_for_pf.Rd

Converts raw acoustic telemetry detections into the format required by particle_filter_positioning(). Unlike the WADE prep function, this preserves exact detection timestamps without temporal aggregation, creating one time step per unique detection time with detecting and non-detecting stations identified.

Usage

prepare_detection_data_for_pf(
  fish_detections,
  station_deployments,
  selected_fish_id,
  start_time,
  end_time,
  min_gap_sec = 60
)

Arguments

fish_detections

Data frame of raw detections with columns: fish_id, station_id, detection_timestamp_utc.

station_deployments

Data frame or sf object of station deployments with columns: station_id, coordinates (x/y or geometry), depth_m, deploy_datetime_UTC, recover_datetime_UTC.

selected_fish_id

Character. Fish ID to process.

start_time

POSIXct. Start of analysis window.

end_time

POSIXct. End of analysis window.

min_gap_sec

Numeric. Minimum seconds between time steps. Detections closer than this are merged into the same time step (default 60).

Value

A data frame with columns: fish_id, time (datetime), station_id, detected (0/1), station_x, station_y, depth_m, detection_prob, n_detections. Compatible with particle_filter_positioning().
